column1: # N2 (H3N2) neuraminidase functional sites. The sialidase active site is a highly
# conserved pocket formed by catalytic residues (that directly contact substrate)
# and framework residues (that stabilise the pocket). These are the standard N2
# numbering positions (Colman, Varghese & Laver 1983), and the app's sequential
# H3N2 NA numbering equals N2 numbering (verified: all 18 residues match), so no
# translation is needed. The renumbered 4GZO chains A-D share this numbering.
